chapterInfo.content:
13
Yɛne ɔman ntam asɛm
1 # Tito 3.1; Yoh 19.11; Mmb 8.15 Momma nnipa nyinaa mmrɛbrɛ wɔn ho ase nhyɛ ɔman mu mpanimfoɔ tumi no ase. Na tumi biara nni hɔ gye deɛ ɛfiri Onyankopɔn; nanso tumi a ɛwowɔ hɔ no, Onyankopɔn na wahyɛ ato hɔ. 2Enti obiara a ɔne tumi no di asie no, ɔne deɛ Onyankopɔn ahyɛ ato hɔ di asie; na wɔn a wɔdi asie no bɛnya afobuo. 3#1 Pe 2.13-14 Na wɔn a wɔdi mpanin no ho nyɛ hu mma wɔn a wɔyɛ nnwuma pa, na mmom wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne. Wompɛ sɛ wosuro tumi no anaa? Ɛnneɛ yɛ papa, na woanya wɔn hɔ ayeyie! 4#Dwom 82.6 Ɛfiri sɛ wɔyɛ Nyankopɔn asomfoɔ ma wo yieyɛ. Na sɛ woyɛ bɔne a, suro, na wɔnkura afena no kwa; na wɔyɛ Nyankopɔn asomfoɔ a wɔtɔ were de abufuo ba deɛ ɔyɛ bɔne no soɔ. 5Enti ɛtwa sɛ mobrɛ mo ho ase hyɛ wɔn ase, ɛnyɛ abufuo no nko nti, na mmom ahonim nso ntira.
6Yei nti nso na moyi toɔ, ɛfiri sɛ wɔyɛ Nyankopɔn asomfo a wɔkura saa ɔsom yi mu ara. 7#Mat 22.21 Montua obiara deɛ ɛsɛ no! Monyi ɛtoɔ ahodoɔ nyinaa mma deɛ ɛtoɔ sɛ no, monsuro deɛ suro sɛ no, monni deɛ anidie sɛ no ni.
Nokorɛ dɔ
8 # Gal 5.14; 1 Ti 1.5 Monnne obiara ka gye sɛ ɔdɔ a mode dodɔ mo ho; na deɛ ɔdɔ ne yɔnko no awie mmara no so di. 9#Eks 20.13-17; Lew 19.18 Na mmara no: Nsɛe awadeɛ, nni awu, mmɔ korɔno, mma w’ani mmmere adeɛ! no, sɛ mmara asɛm biara ka ho a, wɔaka abɔ mu ahyɛ asɛm yi mu sɛ: Dɔ wo yɔnko sɛ wo ho! 10#Mat 22.40 Ɔdɔ nyɛ ɔyɔnko bɔne, enti ɔdɔ ne mmara nyinaa so die.
Kristo da no abɛn
11 # Efe 5.14; 1 Te 5.6-7 Na yei deɛ monim, monim ɛberɛ no, sɛ dɔn a mofiri nna mu sɔreɛ no anya adu, na afei yɛn nkwagyeɛ abɛn akyɛne berɛ a yɛdanee gyidifoɔ no. 12#1 Yoh 2.8; Efe 5.11 Anadwo akɔ n’anim, adekyeeɛ abɛn; enti momma yɛnyi sum mu nnwuma ngu, na yɛnhyɛ hann akodeɛ. 13#Luka 21.34; Efe 5.18 Momma yɛnnante fɛfɛɛfɛ, sɛdeɛ ɛfata hann, ɛnyɛ agobɔne ne nsaborɔ mu, ɛnyɛ adwamammɔ ne ahohwie mu, ɛnyɛ ɔko ne nitan mu; 14#Gal 3.27 na mmom monhyɛ Awurade Yesu Kristo sɛ atadeɛ, na mommma kwan mma ɔhonam akɔnnɔ nni mo so!

pageProps.chapterText:
Momma nnipa nyinaa mmrɛbrɛ wɔn ho ase nhyɛ ɔman mu mpanimfoɔ tumi no ase. Na tumi biara nni hɔ gye deɛ ɛfiri Onyankopɔn; nanso tumi a ɛwowɔ hɔ no, Onyankopɔn na wahyɛ ato hɔ. Enti obiara a ɔne tumi no di asie no, ɔne deɛ Onyankopɔn ahyɛ ato hɔ di asie; na wɔn a wɔdi asie no bɛnya afobuo. Na wɔn a wɔdi mpanin no ho nyɛ hu mma wɔn a wɔyɛ nnwuma pa, na mmom wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne. Wompɛ sɛ wosuro tumi no anaa? Ɛnneɛ yɛ papa, na woanya wɔn hɔ ayeyie! Ɛfiri sɛ wɔyɛ Nyankopɔn asomfoɔ ma wo yieyɛ. Na sɛ woyɛ bɔne a, suro, na wɔnkura afena no kwa; na wɔyɛ Nyankopɔn asomfoɔ a wɔtɔ were de abufuo ba deɛ ɔyɛ bɔne no soɔ. Enti ɛtwa sɛ mobrɛ mo ho ase hyɛ wɔn ase, ɛnyɛ abufuo no nko nti, na mmom ahonim nso ntira.
Yei nti nso na moyi toɔ, ɛfiri sɛ wɔyɛ Nyankopɔn asomfo a wɔkura saa ɔsom yi mu ara. Montua obiara deɛ ɛsɛ no! Monyi ɛtoɔ ahodoɔ nyinaa mma deɛ ɛtoɔ sɛ no, monsuro deɛ suro sɛ no, monni deɛ anidie sɛ no ni.

Monnne obiara ka gye sɛ ɔdɔ a mode dodɔ mo ho; na deɛ ɔdɔ ne yɔnko no awie mmara no so di. Na mmara no: Nsɛe awadeɛ, nni awu, mmɔ korɔno, mma w’ani mmmere adeɛ! no, sɛ mmara asɛm biara ka ho a, wɔaka abɔ mu ahyɛ asɛm yi mu sɛ: Dɔ wo yɔnko sɛ wo ho! Ɔdɔ nyɛ ɔyɔnko bɔne, enti ɔdɔ ne mmara nyinaa so die.

Na yei deɛ monim, monim ɛberɛ no, sɛ dɔn a mofiri nna mu sɔreɛ no anya adu, na afei yɛn nkwagyeɛ abɛn akyɛne berɛ a yɛdanee gyidifoɔ no. Anadwo akɔ n’anim, adekyeeɛ abɛn; enti momma yɛnyi sum mu nnwuma ngu, na yɛnhyɛ hann akodeɛ. Momma yɛnnante fɛfɛɛfɛ, sɛdeɛ ɛfata hann, ɛnyɛ agobɔne ne nsaborɔ mu, ɛnyɛ adwamammɔ ne ahohwie mu, ɛnyɛ ɔko ne nitan mu; na mmom monhyɛ Awurade Yesu Kristo sɛ atadeɛ, na mommma kwan mma ɔhonam akɔnnɔ nni mo so!

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
